headline: Week 9 late games: no lineup changes. Price and Golden carried no injury designation, so keep them in. Inactive lists could not be read this run.
alerts: Lineup is set. No swaps planned before 1:25 PM Pacific.

Jadarian Price (SEA vs. ARI) and Matthew Golden (GB at NE) both lock at 1:25 PM Pacific. Neither had an injury designation. Inactive lists post about 11:55 AM Pacific, so give them a quick look in Sleeper.
If Golden is a surprise inactive, there is no healthy bench WR with a later game. If Price is inactive, Breece Hall already played, so leave the spot or check waivers for a late-game RB.
Jefferson and Hockenson play Monday 5:15 PM Pacific with Carson Wentz at QB. No new injury news found. Keep both in.
Source pages and Sleeper could not be opened this run, so roster moves and inactive lists are not confirmed here.

MIA.note: Hosts Detroit Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Lions -6.5 to -7, total 49.5 to 50.5, Miami about 21.5 implied. RB Jaylen Wright is not expected to play, and Ollie Gordon leads the backfield.

DET.note: At Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. St. Brown (ribs) is active. Lions about 28.5 implied. Kerby Joseph, Jack Campbell, DJ Reed and DJ Wonnum are out.

SEA.note: Hosts Arizona Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Darnold is out and Drew Lock starts. The line fell from Seahawks -11.5 to -8.5 and the total from 44.5 to 39.5, Seattle about 24 implied.

NYG.note: At Philadelphia Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, off a bye. Giants -3 to -3.5, total about 38.5, Giants about 21 implied. Skattebo doubtful, Singletary expected to be the main back.

PHI.note: Hosts the Giants. Joe Milton makes his first NFL start, with Tanner McKee (ribs) active as the backup. Eagles about 17.5 implied.

IND.note: Hosts Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Cowboys -6, total 51.5. Jonathan Taylor is in trade rumors before the Nov 10 deadline.

NYJ.note: At Kansas City Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Chiefs -9.5 to -10, total 47.5 to 48.5, Jets about 19 implied. Garrett Wilson out, Breece Hall back.

MIN.note: Hosts Buffalo Monday 5:15 PM Pacific, indoors. Kyler Murray out, Carson Wentz starts. Bills -3 to -3.5, total about 43.5 to 45.

GB.note: At New England Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Packers about 20.5 implied. Micah Parsons is out.

NE.note: Hosts Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Patriots -3 to -3.5, total 44.5 to 45.5. A.J. Brown and TreVeyon Henderson are out.

CIN.note: Plays Atlanta in Madrid Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. Inactives are posted, none of your players.
